# Nadeem Dev Apps

> Nadeem Mazhar is a solo developer building websites, Windows apps,
> Android apps, and backends, with AI doing the heavy lifting. This site is his
> portfolio; products live as sub-pages.

- [Home](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/nadeem-dev-apps/)
- [Tsumly](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/nadeem-dev-apps/products/tsumly/): local-first personal expense and loan ledger. "Every amount adds up." Smart multi-loan repayment split, optional Google Drive backup.
- [Tsumly Features](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/nadeem-dev-apps/products/tsumly/features/)
- [Tsumly Gallery](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/nadeem-dev-apps/products/tsumly/gallery/)
- [Tsumly About](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/nadeem-dev-apps/products/tsumly/about/)
- [Tsumly Download](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/nadeem-dev-apps/products/tsumly/download/)
- [Kaizenly](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/nadeem-dev-apps/products/kaizenly/): a strict, local-first focus guard, built from scratch.
- [Kaizenly Features](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/nadeem-dev-apps/products/kaizenly/features/)
- [Kaizenly Gallery](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/nadeem-dev-apps/products/kaizenly/gallery/)
- [Kaizenly About](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/nadeem-dev-apps/products/kaizenly/about/)
- [Kaizenly Download](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/nadeem-dev-apps/products/kaizenly/download/)
- [MsgLoop](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/nadeem-dev-apps/products/msgloop/): a WhatsApp sender for Android. Send one message many times, now or on a schedule. Local-first, no account, no server.
- [CV Creator Pro](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/nadeem-dev-apps/products/cv-creator-pro/): a one-page CV maker that runs entirely in the browser — fill it in, pick a look, download a clean A4 PDF.
- [CV Creator Pro Features](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/nadeem-dev-apps/products/cv-creator-pro/features/)
- [CV Creator Pro About](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/nadeem-dev-apps/products/cv-creator-pro/about/)
- Nydrex Suite: an Electron desktop suite for retail — point of sale and inventory, with customer and supplier ledgers and reporting. Windows desktop app, no live site.
- [Brew & Bean Cafe](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/nadeem-dev-apps/products/brew-and-bean/): an animated cafe site with a menu and cart — orders are sent to the cafe as a WhatsApp message. An assignment project, fully working end to end.
- [Brew & Bean Cafe Features](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/nadeem-dev-apps/products/brew-and-bean/features/)
- [Brew & Bean Cafe About](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/nadeem-dev-apps/products/brew-and-bean/about/)

## Concepts

- [Tally Bar](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/nadeem-dev-apps/concepts/tally-bar/): a desk status display with an LED pixel screen and a focus timer. Concept demo — an inspiration template, cleaned and rebranded to Nadeem Dev Apps.
- [Look Out Below](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/nadeem-dev-apps/concepts/look-out-below/): a tiny hand-drawn game about being small, quick and directly underneath a very clumsy sky. Concept demo — an inspiration template, cleaned and rebranded to Nadeem Dev Apps.
- [Stitch & Tan](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/nadeem-dev-apps/concepts/stitch-and-tan/): handmade leather pouches, cases and little things from a one-person studio, plus custom orders. Concept demo — an inspiration template, cleaned and rebranded to Nadeem Dev Apps.
- [ProductSite](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/nadeem-dev-apps/concepts/product-site/): a product site for a calm team workspace — plan, build and ship from one place. Concept demo — an inspiration template, cleaned and rebranded to Nadeem Dev Apps.
- [Portfolio](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/nadeem-dev-apps/concepts/portfolio-concept/): a portfolio concept — oversized name, selected-work grid and case-study pages. Concept demo — an inspiration template, cleaned and rebranded to Nadeem Dev Apps.

## Notes

- The site is a static Astro site. Design tokens live in DESIGN.md in the repo root.
- The Privacy page carries the privacy-policy URL used by the Tsumly app's Google OAuth setup.
- The brand mark is three ascending rounded squares (blue, purple, amber) — "Playful Steps": [logo.svg](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/nadeem-dev-apps/logo.svg).
